Sonia Gandhi’s account of Pranab Mukherjee’s PM ambition and him pushing for a ‘change at the top in 2010’ has sparked debate. Sonia Gandhi has shared this in her recently released memoir ‘Belonging’.
ThePrint Editor-In-Chief Shekhar Gupta traces the politics, interpersonal relations, contradictions and what happened during those years. He also takes us back to Pranab Mukherjee’s account, as described in his memoir.
